children: Park James Franklin, a Director, reported selling common shares at a weighted average price of $11.923 per share. The total sale amount reported was $1,192,300. Following the reported sale of 100,000 shares, the reporting person directly owns 692,118 common shares and indirectly owns 7,805,133 common shares (via Spark Resources LLC and Goodrock LLC). The reporting person disclaims beneficial ownership of the indirectly held shares except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein.
